about.label: About Vkusno
about.lead: A taste of home, wherever home may be
about.paragraph1: Food has the power to bring back memories of home, family, and moments shared around the table. Founded in Dubai in 2021, Vkusno began with a simple idea: to bring the familiar taste and warmth of home-style Russian cooking to the city.
about.paragraph2: Rooted in family recipes and Russia's rich culinary heritage, the brand has grown into a multi-location food business serving authentic, comforting cuisine through delivery, pickup, and relaxed self-service dining.
about.paragraph3: Created with Dubai's Russian-speaking community at heart, Vkusno also welcomes the city's wider audience to discover the richness of Russian cuisine.
